mechanism: Nafcillin induces CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9), reducing chlorpromazine metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations, while chlorpromazine may inhibit nafcillin metabolism to a minor extent.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine effects (sedation, extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostatic hypotension); consider chlorpromazine dose adjustment if nafcillin is initiated or discontinued.
